purpose: Opt-in whole-frequency scheduling and ownership on the frozen Stage 1 documentation case. The frequency route retains all Stage 1 math, cache admission, outputs, and within-frequency operation order.

routes.default: Legacy degree-parallel route, unchanged when DSPEC_FREQUENCY_WORKERS is unset.
routes.frequency: DSPEC_FREQUENCY_WORKERS=1..8 is accepted for dspec and dspec-forward only; CLI solve-workers must remain one. Each complete frequency is statically assigned to one outer OpenMP worker; all inner solve and numerical-library pools remain one.

shared_locked: one stable BatchResponseCache instance across both passes
ownership.cache_identity: The same SEM address, response-cache object, key families, and cache limits are used for initial forward/unit capture and weighted kernel work. No cache policy or implementation is changed.

passes.name: initial_forward_and_unit_adjoint_capture
passes.work: All grid frequencies complete before serial measure(), FFT, window, normalization, and adjoint-spectrum construction.

passes.name: kernel_frequency
passes.work: Each frequency computes its existing sections and first-two-bin tensor/packed validation into private buffers. Parent joins, checks errors, then performs += in original increasing frequency, section, angle, native-node order.

reduction.expression: existing values[section][node*angle_count+angle] += kernelVs(...) is applied by the parent to stored per-bin values in strictly ascending frequency order.
reduction.bound_method: Checked size multiplication and sum; Stage 2 documented L200 sections bound. L3 controls are smaller.

failure: Each task captures its exception in its frequency slot; all assigned tasks finish and join; parent rethrows the lowest failed bin with pass context. No partial result.json is produced.

profiling.worker_capture_lifetime: One WorkerCapture and one fresh WorkerData slot per outer worker per pass, merged by the parent after join.
profiling.diagnostics: Per-frequency snapshots/deltas are parent-merged. Diagnostic worker rows are removed from worker production deltas and emitted once as a separate diagnostic overlay. No worker elapsed sum is subtracted from any master wall interval.
profiling.domain_rule: frequency_worker.* and parallel_worker.* rows are worker_elapsed_sum. All other rows are master_wall. Master exclusive closure excludes both worker domains.
profiling.component_mapping: Exact scope-name mapping seeded from the accepted Stage 1 audited map, with ambiguous shared diagnostic/production scopes corrected to their mathematical component; diagnostic flag and overlay phase identify the separate validation role.

explicit_reporting_map.source: Exact table embedded in the runtime emitter from the 101-scope accepted Stage 1 audited mapping, plus six Stage 2 entries.
explicit_reporting_map.lookup: Strip exactly one worker prefix then exact string match; unknown names remain unclassified; raw scope_name values are unchanged.
